state: create-new immutable protocol; hash before any SCR2 calibration capture

candidate.name: SCR2
candidate.novelty: per-KV-head SST attention-sensitivity covariance plus U*H*Pbr rotation and byte-real asymmetric INT2; not product VQ, IQ2_S, lattice, Hadamard-only, or token selection
candidate.frame: existing KVarN paper frame; paper_frame=true, paper_mixed_frame=false, input_already_rotated=true; K and protected sink/tail/pending unchanged

sst.q: all full_q_body query heads mapped to the selected KV head
formulas: w_t=K_t.T@Cq@K_t; material negative fails, roundoff-negative clamps to zero; normalize sum to body token count
CPU torch.float64 eigh(UPLO=L), deterministic degenerate projector basis, sign anchors
sst.repeated_fit: fp16 R bytes must be byte-identical; fp16 R orthogonality max_abs <=0.005

quantizer.storage: little-endian fp16 min then fp16 scale; q computed from fp32 endpoints; nonfinite or nonpositive serialized scale fails

container.code_order: token-major feature-major; q0 bits0-1, q1 bits2-3, q2 bits4-5, q3 bits6-7
container.trailer: 32-byte raw SHA-256 over every preceding byte
container.gate_denominator: actual represented body values=126*128*D; full-window rate is separately mandatory reporting

calibration.source_policy: only the named calibration fixtures and create-new capture roots are admissible; every prior validation, holdout, result, and exposed capture is forbidden
calibration.first_failure: close SCR2 immediately; do not create a fresh fixture
calibration.freeze_requirement: aggregate all 28 passing calibration unit results into one immutable calibration-freeze before fresh fixture creation

holdout.fixture_creation: only after a passing complete calibration-freeze; create separate new Gemma and Qwen fixtures, then immutable fixture binding before baseline/capture
holdout.fitting: forbidden; load exact per-unit rotation_fp16le from calibration-freeze
holdout.first_failure: close SCR2 immediately; do not evaluate later units

sequence: For each calibration evaluation_order unit: run capture script with exact admitted unit model/fixture/root/topology/runtime fields and serial GPU guard.
Hash capture_launch_receipt.json; run capture_replay_binding.py seal with unit/root/receipt/hash and create source-seal.official.json.
Run scr2_evaluate.py role=calibration with protocol/hash, exact support root, receipt/hash, seal/hash, boundary/call_000000, body-records, record-set earliest, unit and create-new output.
Stop at first hard failure. If all 28 hard-pass, run scr2_aggregate.py role=calibration in exact order; its roster aggregate mean decides the final calibration pass.
Only a passing calibration-freeze authorizes fresh fixture generation/binding. Holdout capture and evaluation use the same serial capture geometry plus required lifecycle manifests; no fitting.
